strings.title: Fall of the Stage Star
strings.hint: Follow the money before jealousy: who recently increased the insurance coverage? And whose signature changed the equipment inspection schedule?
strings.solvedText:
Culprit: her husband, actor Karim Aswad.

His career was collapsing while hers soared. She had privately told him she would divorce him after opening night. Three weeks earlier, he had taken out a substantial stage-injury insurance policy naming himself as beneficiary. He then moved the equipment inspection until after rehearsal and made a calculated partial cut in the suspended platform's cable.

Rita miraculously survived with two fractures and a concussion — and testified. What convicted him: metal filings in his backstage coat pocket, his signature on the schedule change, and a policy paying double for workplace accidents.
strings.summary.text: One day before opening night, during the final rehearsal of the season's play, the suspended platform carrying star Rita Awad collapsed from a height of five meters. She survived with serious injuries. Examination revealed that a blade had cut one-third of the way through the steel cable, causing it to fail at the first downward movement. Backstage that evening: an understudy dreaming of the role, a manager drowning in debt, and a husband smiling a little too much.
strings.summary.victim.name: Rita Awad
strings.summary.victim.note: Survived with injuries — case: attempted murder
strings.summary.timeline[3].l: Rita taken to hospital — stable condition
strings.scene.address: Odeon Theater — stage and upper backstage area
strings.scene.intro: A steel cable cut one-third of the way through does not snap immediately: it fails under the first moving load, exactly as it did during the descent scene. Whoever cut it knew the scene order with the precision of an actor... or a director.
strings.scene.photos[0].cap: Platform's landing point behind the curtain
strings.scene.notes[0]: A calculated partial cut made with a rough blade
strings.scene.notes[1]: Inspection moved to after rehearsal two days earlier
strings.scene.notes[2]: Only 4 people entered the upper backstage area that evening
strings.scene.notes[3]: A recent insurance policy covering stage injuries
strings.evidence[0].title: The Cut Cable
strings.evidence[0].desc: A partial cut made with a rough blade. The cutting angle suggests a hurried hand working at a tall man's shoulder height.
strings.evidence[1].title: Inspection Schedule Change
strings.evidence[1].desc: An amendment form signed in the name of 'Production Management' — the signature is hurried and slanted.
strings.evidence[2].title: Insurance Policy
strings.evidence[2].desc: A substantial occupational-injury policy taken out 3 weeks earlier. Primary beneficiary: the husband.
strings.evidence[3].title: Metal Filings
strings.evidence[3].desc: Fine steel filings matching the cable's strands — in an elegant men's coat.
strings.evidence[4].title: Secret Divorce Message
strings.evidence[4].desc: A draft to her lawyer: 'Serve the papers after opening night — I do not want a scandal before the show.'
strings.evidence[5].title: Upper Backstage Ladder
strings.evidence[5].desc: The heel print of an expensive leather shoe on the dusty steps — not a worker's boot.
strings.suspects[0].name: Understudy Nancy Harb
strings.suspects[0].relation: Takes Rita's place when she is absent
strings.suspects[0].alibi: 'I was memorizing my part in the dressing room — alone, unfortunately.'
strings.suspects[0].statement: Yes, I dreamed of the role. Every understudy does. But anyone who wants a role wants an open theater, not a criminal case that shuts down the whole production. Taking her place that night was a nightmare, not a dream. They applauded while I trembled.
strings.suspects[1].name: Manager Joseph Nakhle
strings.suspects[1].alibi: 'I was in my office negotiating with a creditor over the phone — the call was recorded.'
strings.suspects[1].statement: Rita sells the tickets. Her fall means my complete financial ruin. As for the inspection change, it did not come from my office. Examine the signature: my staff do not sign with such arrogant handwriting.
strings.suspects[2].name: Karim Aswad
strings.suspects[2].relation: Plays a supporting role in the same production
strings.suspects[2].alibi: 'I was reviewing my scene on the left side backstage.'
strings.suspects[2].statement: My wife is my life. Her fall almost killed me first. The policy? A professional precaution every respectable theater company takes. I arranged it out of concern for her. Schedules and cables are technical matters an actor like me does not understand.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Lighting technician
strings.witnesses[0].statement: Two hours before rehearsal, I saw Mr. Karim coming down the upper ladder. He said he was 'looking for somewhere quiet to learn his lines.' Actors never go up there.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Assistant director
strings.witnesses[1].statement: The inspection amendment arrived in an internal envelope. Strangely, nobody in production knew anything about it.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Rita Awad
strings.witnesses[2].statement: A week earlier, Karim jokingly asked: 'If you fell from the platform in the third scene, who would collect the insurance?' I laughed then. I am not laughing now.
strings.folders[0].name: Incident reports
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: Theater Injury Report
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: An ambulance was called after a suspended platform fell during rehearsal. The case became a criminal investigation following the cable examination.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic evidence
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Cable Examination Report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: A precisely calculated partial blade cut, designed to hold a stationary load and fail during movement — attempted murder, not negligence.
strings.folders[1].docs[1].title: Filings Analysis Report
strings.folders[1].docs[1].body: Steel filings in the coat pocket match the cable strands. The costume designer identified the coat as the husband's.
strings.folders[2].name: Interviews
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Understudy Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: She broke down crying. No trace of her was found on the upper ladder, and her shoe size does not match.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: Manager Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: The recorded call with the creditor covers the estimated time of the cutting.
strings.folders[2].docs[2].title: Husband Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[2].body: He denied climbing the upper ladder. Confronted with the lighting technician's testimony and the heel print, he requested a lawyer.
strings.folders[3].name: Records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: Policy Record
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: An occupational-injury policy doubling compensation inside the theater. The husband personally requested it 3 weeks earlier.
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Signature Comparison
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: The signature on the inspection amendment closely matches the husband's handwriting; the slant of the final letter is distinctive.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: Rita's Full Statement
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: She told him about her decision to divorce 10 days earlier. They agreed to keep it secret until after opening night. 'He was frighteningly calm.'
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: The Husband's Money Trail
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: Accumulated gambling debts and a loan secured against the insurance policy itself a week earlier.
strings.reports[0].title: Reconstruction Report
strings.reports[0].author: Scene examination team
strings.reports[0].body: The cable was cut between 18:20 and 19:00 by someone who knew the inspection had been postponed. The cutting angle and height rule out the understudy.
strings.reports[1].title: Financial Motive Report
strings.reports[1].author: Financial investigation unit
strings.reports[1].body: A complete triangle: a recent policy, crushing debts, and an imminent divorce that would leave him with nothing.
strings.notes[0].text: Whoever postponed the inspection cut the cable
strings.notes[1].text: The policy pays double inside the theater — coincidence?
